settings.text_heading: Warranty — trust you can build on, three decades of experience
settings.textarea_text: Quality is our priority and the foundation of your trust in DICOTA. While rare, defects can occur despite strict testing. As a DICOTA customer, you can rely on our comprehensive warranty services for support.

settings.text_heading: At DICOTA, we attach great importance to long-lasting materials and careful processing.
settings.textarea_text: Extensive test procedures and continuous development result in long-lasting solutions, backed up by a lifetime* warranty for any possible material and processing defects with notebook bags. *Due to legal restrictions in Germany, only for a period of 30 years. No time restrictions in other countries.
For DICOTA accessories, tablet cases, wheeled notebook bags, electronic components, hard-shell products and custom solutions.
Life is too short to be complicated — register your case online.
You can extend your warranty to 36 or 48 months when you buy mobile office solutions, ensuring longer protection for valuable equipment.
DICOTA does not accept liability for third-party products, meaning DICOTA does not cover damage to equipment used with DICOTA products.
